notes.title: Official Early Access Release! We are live!
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2363590/extras/HIA_Gameplay.gif?t=1691265590

Hey guys!

Rob & Wim here, the developers.

We just wanted to let you know that our game is now live and that we appreciate anyone checking it out! 

We are two brothers who set out to make a fun horror game, which we can all enjoy with friends.

We are working on a lot of features/content and would appreciate your feedback.

Join our Discord to let us know what you think.

Here is a little overview of what we aim to add
in the next few months:

• More missions and gameplay features
• More monsters
• More maps
• More character customization options
• More emotes, gestures and other fun social features
• More equipment: Melee weapons, More flashlights, Medkits, 
  Bandages, Tools
• Leveling system: XP, Level Up
• Reward system: Earn money by playing missions, spend that 
  money on fun things (Player customization, Lobby customization)

Thanks for joining us!

We make rapid updates and iterations to the game on a weekly basis, so be on the lookout.

Rob & Wim
© Kekdot 2023

PS: If there’s bugs please report them to us lol
